The structure of CaMn6O11 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a 36-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca centers coordinated by eight O neighbors, while Mn adopts several environments, including six-coordinate O coordination, and O centers are seven- or eight-coordinate. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Mn-centered six- and seven-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Ca- and Mn-centered eight-vertex polyhedra.
